Conditional defect probabilities under the determinant-magnitude-weighted law, not just raw Gaussian probability, yield Delta=(1+(K-1)p)^n-1+2np. An acquired phase lower bound s>Delta gives relative floor bias<=Delta/(s-Delta).

For f=log|wtilde|, beta=224g/(25kappa^2) bounds Hessian norm. Mode mu=grad f(mu) is acquired by contraction where the gate passes, with residual correction. Independent Gaussian importance samples have relative variance<=exp[n beta^2/(1-2beta)^2]/s^2-1 for exact mode and beta<1/2, with a specified approximate-mode replacement. Chebyshev samples and floor bias are charged separately. No mixing, burn-in or time-step bias occurs. Dense memory is O(n^2), sample work O(n^3), plus mode factorizations, n Gaussian variates, branch-safe arithmetic and precision. The floating executable lacks outward-rounded gates, finite-bit noise and complete accumulated errors.

The surviving local operation restores a quartic coordinate before sampling. For g>0, real J!=0, Re d>=0, Re h>0 and f0(x)=exp(-d x^2/2-gx^4/4), F(h)=h^-1/2 J_g(d+J^2/h)=|J|^-1[exp(h partial_x^2/(2J^2))f0](0), with J_g the normalized quartic integral. A Fourier representation extends continuously to Re h=0, bounds |F| by acquired Fourier/Sobolev norms and gives limit1/|J| at h=0. Explicit derivative polynomials and quartic moments give finite-order remainder bounds. This is not a holomorphic removable singularity in a disk or convergence of the infinite heat Taylor series. Small |J|, high derivatives, block dimensions and certified gamma arithmetic cost resources.

The small-pivot block has determinant hd+J^2, so h=0 alone is not a resonance. A separate true fixture M_eta(U)=[[eta-i,-i],[-i,eta-i(1+sqrt(2)U)]], U Gaussian, has raw sampled second moment log(1/eta)/sqrt(pi)+O(1), while exact conditional mean tends exp(i pi/4)Gamma(1/4)/(2sqrt(pi)), nonzero modulus about1.02277. Real invertible block coupling extends the identity, but tiny singular values, determinant/Fourier norms, complex fill-in and uncovered singular directions prevent an uncharged recursion.

The matched16-site chain uses identical coefficients and log-ratio output: transfer about.112s,25000-draw estimator about.939s plus mode acquisition, two-order Wick about.000096s. Transfer convergence is not an interval enclosure; Wick lacks a general remainder; the stochastic guarantee is ideal arithmetic. Connected grid tests increase kappa with size and lack independently certified large-grid answers. Useful floor bounds retreat to small g/kappa^2, so the source stops this estimator as a breakthrough direction. N746 remains intact with its distinct paired-quartic contract.

The open global operation must acquire manageable true-resonance blocks at ordinary fixed couplings, retain any data-dependent selection event inside the conditional integral, bound determinant-weighted large-block contributions and residual global phase, and compare equally certified outputs with strong contour/tensor/interpolation methods.
